plugins.name: adhd-working-mode
plugins.description: Created to support my ADHD, probably useful for everyone. Always-on Claude Code working-mode skill that helps you stay in-flow, action-first, one step at a time. Transparent by default.

plugins.name: memory-inherit
plugins.description: Claude Code's memory is keyed to the exact working directory, so a repo checkout and every git worktree under it each get their own empty store — memory reads as blank exactly where you do most of your work, with no error to tell you. This makes it inherit: on session start it links the current directory at the nearest ancestor that already has memory.
